title: Melt the self into praise
summary: In praise, the separate self softens and begins to merge with the Lord. Move toward the company that steadies the heart.
takeaway: Move toward the company that steadies the heart.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.

source.shortMeaning: In praise, the separate self softens and begins to merge with the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind hardens, stay with praise until the edge begins to soften.

evidence.coreClaim: In praise, the separate self softens and begins to merge with the Lord.
evidence.turn: Let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.
